instruction: Inspect both images. For every opaque token, return two independent labels. physical_roles describes visible/source layout: MASTHEAD, HEADER, TEXT, OTHER, or UNKNOWN. A heading inside an advertisement is physically HEADER and its prose is TEXT. editorial_genres describes function: ARTICLE, ADVERT, NOTICE, MASTHEAD, OTHER, or UNKNOWN. Thus one token may be physical HEADER and editorial ADVERT. Page-title/date/page-number fragments belong to the physical MASTHEAD convention; ordinary section/item headings are HEADER. Do not return eligibility, order, groups, articles, or transcription: frozen software derives stream membership, order and units from physical roles only. Mark uncertainty separately for each axis. Tokens are random. Return JSON only.

selected_on: post-score convention audit of consumed page 0029

axis_policy.physical_role: describes the block's visible layout function; advertisement headings and bodies remain HEADER/TEXT
axis_policy.editorial_genre: describes subject/function independently; it cannot remove a region from the physical reading stream
axis_policy.stream_membership: derived by software: HEADER and TEXT included; MASTHEAD, OTHER and UNKNOWN excluded
axis_policy.semantic_units: derived by the frozen header-boundary CPU rule from physical roles only
axis_policy.genre_truth_status: proposal only: the distributed corpus has no independently adjudicated editorial genre labels

export_policy.physical: ALTO regions plus physical METS structure
export_policy.logical: separate METS logical divisions; genre retained with provenance and confidence status
export_policy.advertising: readable unit retained for OCR and retrieval even when excluded from a news-article view

frozen_profile.reference_warning: Source physical roles/order/SSU remain provisional; editorial genres have no independent reference.

leakage_control: Random tokens reveal no source ID, order, role, genre or semantic unit. XML, binding and reference are outside the reader packet.
binding_control: Strict software validation binds both complete maps; no repair is permitted.
reference_warning: Physical role/order/SSU are provisional corpus labels. Editorial genre has no adjudicated reference and is not scored. Page 0039 is consumed after scoring.
